changes: - **Registration in one frame** (`EndFaceRegistration`): each end's reference is the median of its first 10 faces and then locks; scans stay raw until their end's reference is locked (at most 40), so older voxels never sit at a superseded reference. A 60-scan synthetic with a 0.3 m box-bias change and a rear-to-front transition keeps both end slabs within 5 cm of a perfectly registered track (v4: 0.32 m rear slab). Neutral on the 10-scan harness by construction.

- **One switching policy** (`TypePosterior`): the fitter returns the best-ranked type; only the posterior switches. Sweeps vote only when observable (>= 150 voxels over >= 12 coverage cells); until then the box-size type is kept. Screened-out types enter `type_nats` with their screen nats (at least the worst refined type) instead of the worst refined value. A confident type is latched (established) and leaves only for the same challenger leading by 3 nats on two consecutive votes.

- **Observable rise only** (`TopProfile`): the rise is unknown unless >= 2 bins (0.25 m) hold >= 3 returns above 0.7 H (a low side panel no longer reads as rise 0 = -8 nats for sedans); bins need 5 returns beyond 15 m; rise nats are capped at 8 x min(1, cells/20). Center-line tops (|y| < 0.3 W) were tried and reverted (dev exact -4).
- **Upper-envelope term deleted**: with the envelope weight at 0, dev exact +1 / p90 -3 mm and val exact +1, group +2, p90 -5 mm, so the envelope machinery (~90 lines) is removed.

- **Legacy fallback** (`VehicleAppearanceConfig.min_publish_evidence = 100`, `publish_prior_shape = False`): no shape is published (legacy primitive) below 100 evidence voxels or after a rejected fit (rms > 0.25 m); the dimension-prior type mean is no longer published before a fit. Dev+val pooled (119 scored vehicles), v4 -> v5: per-vehicle p90 median 0.168 -> 0.162 m, 90th percentile over vehicles 0.395 -> 0.364 m (legacy 0.385), vehicles whose fit is worse than legacy by > 2 cm 21 -> 11.

- **Harness motion fix**: GT motion (`gt_motion_m`, `motion_front_sign`) is now measured from the earliest to the latest pose in time; at a sequence start the history includes frames after t, and v4 measured from t to a later frame, which made take12 #9/#13/#32 look like they drive against their heading. They drive forward, so no heading correction is added (a motion-based heading flip remains an open item).

- Latency: incumbent-only refits stop after 4 LM iterations (warm start); per-bin TopProfile percentiles are vectorized. Standalone (50 dumped dev tracks, 1 thread): incumbent p95 20.9 -> 10.6 ms, sweep p95 73 -> 68 ms.

- Tried and reverted: sweep on every fit until the type is confident (dev exact 37 -> 34), recent-scan acceptance (newest scan vs type mean, +0.02 m: type -1, q90 +3 mm), rise sigma 0.45/0.6 (net 0 exact), publishing nothing before a fit without the rejection rule (dev p90 +2 mm), rms rejection at 0.18/0.20 m (median +5-8 mm).

- Live cadence (`--live-schedule`, 10 past scans, every GT car within 80 m a track): 1.3 refits per track in that second (every-scan harness: 9.3), shapes published for 41/70 dev and 53/105 val vehicles by frame t (median delay 3 scans), so live types and shapes lag the every-scan numbers (dev exact 29/38). `max_fits_per_update = 4` doubles the refits (2.4 per track) but is left at 2 pending an on-vehicle CPU check.

- Harness: per-type nats split in `type_trace` (data / dims / rise / 0.1 prior), `type_probability`, `type_confident`, `decided_type`; `--no-color` for shape-only passes; `--live-schedule` replays the past frames through `VehicleAppearanceEstimator` (cadence, budget, freezing, publication; no future frames) with `--appearance` overrides; `--min-publish-evidence 0` restores the v4 publication policy.
